podcast.title: Formation in 1952
podcast.body: The group was formed in 1952 with Paul Burlison on lead guitar, Dorsey Burnette on stand-up bass, and Johnny Burnette on rhythm guitar and lead vocals. "The three of them formed a group in 1952, the rhythm rangers."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 44: "Train Kept A-Rollin'", by Johnny Burnette and the Rock 'n' Roll Trio

podcast.title: Name Change to The Rock and Roll Trio
podcast.body: A year after their formation, the band changed its name to The Rock and Roll Trio. "A year later they changed their name to the Rock and Roll trio."
